query:
ALTER TABLE tickets 
  CHANGE COLUMN drawId draw_id INT NOT NULL,
  CHANGE COLUMN userId user_id INT NOT NULL,
  CHANGE COLUMN ticketNumber ticket_number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  CHANGE COLUMN totalPaid total_paid INT NOT NULL,
  CHANGE COLUMN paymentStatus payment_status ENUM('pending', 'confirmed', 'failed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  CHANGE COLUMN paymentMethod payment_method VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'pix',
  CHANGE COLUMN pixQrCode pix_qr_code TEXT,
  CHANGE COLUMN pixCopyPaste pix_copy_paste TEXT,
  CHANGE COLUMN stripePaymentIntentId stripe_payment_intent_id VARCHAR(255),
  CHANGE COLUMN stripeCheckoutSessionId stripe_checkout_session_id VARCHAR(255),
  CHANGE COLUMN createdAt created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CHANGE COLUMN updatedAt updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
